points.text: sum of potential and kinetic energies (of molecules/atoms);
(in ideal gas) no intermolecular forces so no potential energy;
internal energy is (solely) kinetic energy (of particles);
(mean) kinetic energy (of particles) proportional to (thermodynamic) temperature
